periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Launched the online resource directory in January and sent 22 messages about 988, including bus-shelter posters in English and Spanish. The directory logged 3,150 sessions in its first quarter. Partners: Public Safety 911 center, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add QR codes to the bus-shelter posters and place directory kiosks in library branches.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added QR codes to bus-shelter posters and set up directory kiosks in three library branches, and sessions grew to 4,380. Sent 31 messages, adding school newsletters for the first time. Partners: Public Safety 911 center, Parks/Rec/Libraries, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Run bilingual radio spots and redesign the directory landing page so crisis lines appear first.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Sent 37 outreach messages, including bus-shelter ads and bilingual radio spots, and refreshed the directory landing page so crisis lines appear first. Directory sessions reached 5,920, a 35% jump over Q2. Partners: Public Safety 911 center, Coastal Behavioral Health, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add wallet cards in three languages to the Seaport Workers Clinic waiting area, and test whether text-message reminders lift directory visits.
